name: proposal-team
description:
A Managed Team that assesses opportunities, responds to solicitations, and reviews proposals, delivering the proposal work your team otherwise would not have time to complete.

It analyzes solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria, assesses capability fit, gaps, risk, ROI, and pricing, researches the opportunity and competitive landscape, develops positioning and win themes, drafts the response, and reviews it for requirements coverage, compliance, consistency, and quality.

Configure the team with your company profile, pricing, past performance, case studies, brand guidelines, and review criteria. Run the work autonomously or direct it stage by stage. Receive completed research, response strategy, proposal content, compliance reporting, review findings, recommendations, and next actions. You retain the final pursue, pricing, content, outreach, and submission decisions.
